closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, omega 3, and fibre, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin E, low zinc, and anti-nutrients matter. It is good for heart health, digestion, and muscles and strength sports because fibre supports the heart-health side, fibre supports digestion and steadier meals, and the protein section supports repair and maintenance.
